**Average (median) house price in California (2024‑mid)**  
- **Median listing price:** ≈ $850 000  
- **Average (mean) price:** ≈ $1 050 000  

> *Sources:*  
> • Zillow Research – “California Home Prices” (latest quarterly report, Q2 2024)  
> • Redfin Data Center – “California Median Home Price” (2024‑06)  
> • U.S. Census Bureau – ACS 5‑Year Estimates (housing market trends)

> **Quick note:**  
> - The *median* price is often used to describe the typical home value because it is less affected by extreme high‑price listings.  
> - The *average* (mean) price is higher because a small number of very expensive homes pull the mean upward.
